evidence: Alumina ﬁlms are represented by slightly rippled surface proﬁles, as shown in the inset of ﬁgure 1(b), and their local thicknesses are determined to be 0.8–1.1 nm. The surface roughness of alumina ﬁlms signiﬁcantly improves with further deposition, and an extremely smooth layer with a thickness of 1.6 nm is produced after ten cycles (see ﬁgure 1(c)).
